messages:
maggie: quick postmortem follow-up from the 03/18 inference latency incident — collated actions and a small SOP tweak proposal. TL;DR: add explicit triage checklist items for model-variant fallback and prefix/KV cache checks, include a safe `hotfix` command snippet, and clarify oncall -> runtime -> platform escalation path within 30m.

devon: SGTM. can we also add `model-variant fallback` check to the checklist? saw repeats of that in two incidents.

maggie: yes. ordering proposed: 1) confirm scope (customers, models), 2) model-variant fallback, 3) prefix/KV cache, 4) autoscaler backlog, 5) fallback to smaller model.

samir: owners + timelines: devon runbook edits (PR by EOD Tue), anya automation tests for checklist (PR in 7 days), lisa escalation diagram + contacts (EOW). I'll track verification and close items.

anya: for automation tests I need exact commands to assert cache health — can we standardize?

maggie: adding suggested commands to SOP draft below. sanity-check please:
```
# check prefix/KV cache health (inference namespace)
redwoodctl cache inspect --namespace=inference --prefix=kv_prefix --show-stats
# flush prefix if corrupted (use with care)
redwoodctl cache flush --namespace=inference --prefix=kv_prefix --confirm
# confirm model fallback config is present
redwoodctl model get-config --model=redwood-alpha --show-fallbacks
# quick autoscaler backlog check
kubectl -n inference get hpa -o wide
# health endpoint latency capture
curl -sS -w "%{time_total}" -o /dev/null https://inference.svc/healthz
```

devon: looks good. add sample outputs and a clear "DANGER" callout for `cache flush` with confirm flag reminder. I'll include in PR.

lisa: escalation diagram: propose a hard 30-minute SLA to contact runtime after oncall tags runtime lead. add explicit phone/SMS step for after-hours. will update contact list.

maggie: recurring incident pattern detection — add a checkbox in the postmortem template to mark if incident matches a known pattern (cache thrash, autoscaler oversubscribe, tokenization edgecase). if yes, route to Pattern Owners board and schedule deeper RCA.

samir: 👍 I'll create the tracking ticket and link to runbook PR.

anya: small nit: make commands copy-paste-safe (no wrapping) and include short example output for `redwoodctl cache inspect` so oncall knows expected shape.

devon: will include sample output and a short troubleshooting note for common cache metrics (hit_rate, eviction_count).

maggie: final owners + deadlines recap: devon (runbook PR) by EOD Tue, anya (automation tests) in 7 days, lisa (escalation + contacts) by EOW, samir (tracking ticket + verification) tomorrow. I'll post a checklist in the incidents board and follow up. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Reminder: Created task INCIDENT-4921 "SOP tweaks: cache/fallback triage + escalation diagram" assigned to samir, due 2026-03-25.

lisa: noted, will update calendar contacts too. :phone:

samir: thanks all, will post tracking link once created.

maggie: thanks team — closing thread for updates, will re-open if blockers. :thumbsup:
